card.name: Hematocrit wording and dosing instruction commas
card.fires_on: Mostly the "oc" inside "hematocrit" when describing lower values. Also scattered small words and commas in dosing instructions, such as the comma in a list of injection sites.

modes.label: Inside hematocrit
modes.description: The "oc" piece in the middle of the word hematocrit.

modes.description: Linking words or spaces in dosing and administration phrases.
modes.example: Administer TREMFYA<< by>> subcutaneous injection at Week 0
